name: Jenny Greenteeth

attributes.attribute: a British water spirit haunting Lancashire streams who sought to drown passersby

sources: Spence, Lewis. The Minor Traditions of British Mythology. (New York: Benjamin Blom, Inc., 1972), 13.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jenny Greenteeth is a British water spirit. She was a boggart, or threatening sprite, known until the nineteenth century. Jenny haunted the streams of Lancashire, seeking to drown passersby. Such spirits may descend from early water divinities. They may encode a faint folk memory of human sacrifice. Some scholars think Jenny was only a nursery tale. The threat of a green-toothed monster in pools kept adventurous children away from danger.
objective: Document Jenny Greenteeth as a British water spirit of Lancashire.
key_results: Record her haunting of Lancashire streams.
Note the theories of water divinities and human sacrifice.
